name: HUAYANG
recent: Hua Yang 近期完成子公司 Prisma Pelangi 出售 Magna Prima 约 5.66% 股权，套现 RM16.498m 用于偿还银行贷款，并更正了交易日期。公司也刚在 2026 年 9 月 2 日召开常年股东大会，所有议案均获通过。
notable: 子公司 Prisma Pelangi 以 RM16.498m 现金出售 Magna Prima 22,600,000 股（约 5.66% 股权），所得用于偿还银行贷款。
2026 年 9 月 2 日举行的常年股东大会通过所有议案，包括董事费、董事连任及重新委任核数师。

news.title: Frankly Speaking: A breach is a breach, regardless of size

recent_en: Hua Yang recently completed the disposal of a 5.66% stake in Magna Prima by subsidiary Prisma Pelangi for RM16.498m cash to repay bank borrowings, and corrected the transaction date. The company also held its AGM on 2 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed.
notable_en: Subsidiary Prisma Pelangi disposed of 22,600,000 Magna Prima shares (about 5.66% stake) for RM16.498m cash, with proceeds used to repay bank borrowings.
The AGM held on 2 September 2026 passed all resolutions, including directors' fees, re-election of directors and re-appointment of auditors.
